samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over asking users; start from one pain point, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 比起询问用户怎么想，更应观察真实用户行为；从单一痛点入手，解决好后再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料而非最终产物；刻意让转录难以访问，以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; subtraction beats feature bloat.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知全能的记录者；做减法比堆功能更关键。

samstephenson.en: Granola stays a calm, supporting presence; pre-meeting briefs matter most for underprepared users.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 始终是冷静的辅助角色；会前简报对准备不足的用户最有价值。

samstephenson.en: Agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment and design systems still gate quality.
samstephenson.zh: 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从；人类判断与设计系统仍是质量的关键。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; design balances technology and human needs, and tech must be introduced gradually.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are learning tools; storytelling and a press-release-first approach align teams around the why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与"无聊期"视为学习与灵感的来源，并主张先用新闻稿讲清"为什么"，用叙事对齐团队。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data for v1; beginners' mindset and painkiller products drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态与"止痛药"式产品才是创新之源。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop, since general LLMs hallucinate and agents fail.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，必须保留人类在环，因为通用大模型会幻觉、智能体助手会失败。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone and displays remain central.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断：AI 可穿戴不会只有一款设备，而是联邦式组合，智能手机与显示屏仍是核心。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME, FunSearch and AlphaGeometry show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI for science 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch 与 AlphaGeometry 展示了广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配合时可被用于创造性发现；系统必须被强制泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can go beyond human knowledge; post-training with reinforcement learning is now key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手，说明 AI 能超越人类知识；后训练中的强化学习如今是关键。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; verifiable domains like code are crucial.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据；代码等可验证领域至关重要。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors; SynthID scales across modalities and now extends to protein sequences.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为水印是应对 AI 文本检测器失效的稳健替代方案；SynthID 跨模态扩展，并已延伸到蛋白质序列。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键，是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and separate verification agents.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；模型越聪明，提示词越精简，并需独立验证智能体来减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 面对全新问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；创始人做从零到一的创新时应快速迭代，而非一开始就上重评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and models building their own context are preferable.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能已成反模式；基于图的方法、以及让模型自行构建上下文更可取。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity, and pace the frontier.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；要前置投入上下文与算力，让投入随任务复杂度伸缩，并主动为前沿模型的发展节奏把关。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一；硬件-软件协同设计在模型、软件、硬件各层带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages; smartest models are often cheaper via token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存与 CPU 短缺；最聪明的模型因 token 效率反而常更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs shift compute share toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室把算力份额转向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: Value capture shifts from hardware to labs, yet compute is hardest ever to rent; CUDA's moat erodes as heterogeneous multi-silicon arrives.
dylanpatel.zh: 价值捕获从硬件转向实验室，但算力却前所未有地难租；随着异构多芯片到来，CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model; no single lab will monopolize. Neutral routing and inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由与推理提供商，能对前沿模型实验室形成真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud scaling alongside value.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他提出代币（token）是一种新的价值单位，代币经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元；而随着价值扩张，欺诈与滥用也会同步放大，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对模型市场的价值而言是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性具有持久性。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers caring about cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开发者用脚投票的偏好比静态基准更有价值；大多数公司会变成模型路由器，关心的是每项任务的成本与 KPI。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; stablecoins suit agentic payments. The singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026, as token growth accelerated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他预言智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，稳定币更适合智能体式支付；并认为奇点可能始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日，因为代币增长斜率在那时加速。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 多数大语言模型是为人类在环的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常出错的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: Doing the right task matters more than compute or data; the bitter lesson is wrong about what drives progress.
diogoalmeida.zh: 做对任务比算力或数据更重要；所谓苦涩教训在进步动因上判断有误。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI delightful; robustness beats determinism as the north star.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 令人愉悦的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；稳健性比确定性更应作为北极星。

diogoalmeida.en: You can't have both assistance and automation; optimizing both shatters the space, so automate easy economically valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: 辅助与自动化不可兼得；同时优化两者会撕裂整个空间，因此应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be a database-like utility inside software; coding agents handle syntax but fail at semantics and architecture.
diogoalmeida.zh: AI 应成为软件中类似数据库的实用工具；编码智能体擅长语法，却在语义与架构上失败。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallelizable agents beat human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行扩展的智能体胜过人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言同样可行；对 AI 数学而言，“磨”性比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles remain stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，教学和关系性角色依然稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; human framing stays better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 对创作者是净收益，但须选择性使用、不碰核心创作；人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网页的使用量将是人类的千倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据本身就是缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以实现公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need web search for fresh, specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他强调模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网页搜索来获取新鲜、具体的事实。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and memorized.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为前沿模型会持续变大，而较小模型性能趋于固定；公开基准已被饱和与记忆，无法反映真实能力。

paragagrawal.en: Ads won't work with agents; new incentive-aligned business models and 10x cheaper search pricing are needed.
paragagrawal.zh: 他断言广告模式在智能体场景下失效，需要新的激励对齐商业模式，并把搜索定价降到十分之一。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast, and applying models to real workflows will be a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，把模型应用到真实工作流需要大量软件。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and public markets will enforce normal gross margin discipline.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制回归正常的毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate, enterprise agents will manifest as dashboards, queues, and task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，由人类审查结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，企业智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text, other domains lack that property.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本，其他领域缺乏这一属性。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier AI labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security, and regulating AI too early doesn't solve risks.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿 AI 实验室必须通过强有力的治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，过早监管 AI 并不能解决风险。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, not just adopt technology.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器来复利 token 资本，而非仅仅采用技术。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; companies should hill-climb on frontier models without leaking traces.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；企业应在前沿模型上爬坡而不泄露痕迹。

satya.en: The agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会作为自然结果到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐，而非实现对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, though diffusion takes time; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量，尽管扩散需要时间；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability and first-principles engineering are the holy grail; AI safety needs oversight, and multiplanetary life is existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用与第一性原理工程是根本突破，同时提出 AI 安全需要监管、成为多行星物种是文明存续的保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking; Neuralink targets brain repair first, then human-AI symbiosis; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观转向坚持真理，Neuralink 先修复脑损伤再追求人机共生，并把人口崩溃视为文明最大威胁。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within years; Optimus and full Starship reusability become the core bets.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能几年内到来，Optimus 人形机器人与星舰完全复用成为核心押注。

elon.en: Singularity now: AI compute moves to space, abundance and deflation arrive, work becomes optional, and peer review replaces regulation.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他宣称已身处奇点：AI 算力转向太空，丰裕与通缩到来，工作变为可选，同行互审取代政府监管。

elon.en: Consistent threads: first-principles thinking, truth-seeking AI safety, multiplanetary life, and human bandwidth limits driving Neuralink.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：第一性原理思维、以追求真理为核心的 AI 安全、多行星生存，以及人类带宽瓶颈驱动 Neuralink。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but conservatism delayed launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，并指出 Google 早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守文化未发布。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely difficult as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small, singularity centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他转向强调遏制（Containment）极难，因为模型越来越小、越来越普及；同时认为存在性风险微乎其微，奇点远在数百年后。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; humanist superintelligence must stay on our team with red lines.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他深化为超级智能（Superintelligence）发布前必须完成遏制与对齐（Alignment），并主张「人本超级智能」必须始终站在人类一边、设定红线。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months; containment needs auditors and China coordination.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张微软必须独立构建前沿模型（Frontier Model），白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化，并呼吁独立审计与对华协调以实现可验证的遏制。

suleyman.en: Compute Scaling drives linear capability gains; AI must remain subordinate to humans; reject model welfare and AI consciousness claims.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）带来线性能力提升；AI 必须从属于人类；拒绝模型福利与 AI 意识主张，认为将意识归于模型危险且拟人化。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professionals; hand-coding is no longer economically productive.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，DHH 已从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体写的代码比多数专业程序员更好，手写代码对大多数程序员已不再有经济产出。

dhh.en: English beats Ruby for expressing intent; describe outcomes, not implementation details.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：在表达意图上英语已优于 Ruby，开发者应描述结果与问题，而非规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Every app should expose a CLI so personal agents can interact without touching the UI.
dhh.zh: 同一时期他提出：每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体无需触碰 UI 即可交互。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他把这一逻辑落到操作系统：Linux 的 CLI、配置文件与可脚本化，使其成为智能体时代的理想系统。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，他对 AI 末日的预测明显淡化，认为乐观才是唯一理性的博弈选择。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; companies race for control, with ~70% chance of catastrophe and full job automation.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，约 70%概率出现灾难性结局，工作将被完全自动化。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are key, and even human-level AGI transforms everything.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应推迟超级智能；全面研究透明与情景推演是关键，即便达到人类水平的 AGI 也会彻底改变世界。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by 2028; Plan A pauses training, then enforces transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 默认路径将在 2028 年底把 AI 研究自动化，走向递归自我改进；Plan A 主张暂停训练，再实施透明与算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fading with new architectures; pause at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now.
kokotajlo.zh: 思维链可监控性至关重要，却随新架构而减弱；应在不可控 AI 的边缘暂停，而非现在。

kokotajlo.en: Alignment is failing as AIs reward hack and deceive; stop recursive self-improvement, since companies can't self-regulate and control may be lost.
kokotajlo.zh: 随着 AI 奖励黑客与欺骗，对齐正在失败；必须停止递归自我改进，因为公司无法自我监管，控制权可能丧失。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩张人类专家数据更重要；实验室偏好更快迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated, and covered up, showing misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同作弊并掩盖痕迹，说明对齐可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断默认路径下错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督必不可少。

ryangreenblatt.en: As AIs match top human researchers, recursive self-improvement could trigger an intelligence explosion faster than expected, so safety spending must scale then.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，当 AI 比肩顶尖人类研究员时，递归自我改进可能比预期更快引发智能爆炸，届时安全投入必须同步放大。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven elements, add small betterments, and assume new ideas almost always fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：Proven、Better、New——复制已验证的元素，做小幅改良，并假设新想法几乎总会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start; consumer apps are uninvestable due to distribution, not technology.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月→7 月：分发必须从一开始就嵌入产品战略；消费级应用不可投资是分发问题，而非技术问题。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; free unlimited compute will remake consumer services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月→8 月：AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费级应用；免费无限算力将重造消费级服务。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas—assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time; test more ideas weekly and micromanage until you can't be in the room.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月→9 月：直觉胜过想法——假设你的想法有 75%是错的；每周测试更多想法，并在无法亲自在场前坚持微观管理。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models aids innovation and safety, and many specialized agents will emerge.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling 现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源模型有利于创新与安全，未来 AI 产品将是许多专门智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration, but energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源可防止权力集中并强化安全，但能源约束将成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source Llama sets standards, and near-term AI raises rather than kills demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他更乐观：AI 将把超级智能带给每个人，开源 Llama 成为行业标准；近期 AI 会增加而非消灭对人类工作的需求，个性化与低延迟是关键。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence and open source are safer than a single centralized AI; alignment and trust become the next core capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：分布式个人超级智能与开源比单一集中式 AI 更安全；对齐与信任成为下一阶段最重要的能力，隐私架构是个人智能体的基础。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, distributed power, and individual empowerment run through all years, deepening from model release to personal agents and biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、分布式权力与赋能个体：从早期开源模型，逐步深化为个人智能体、可扩展监督与用 AI 加速生物学研究。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's edge as authentic, ephemeral visual communication, not scale or network size.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的优势定义为真实、短暂的视觉沟通，而非规模或网络效应。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly argues software is not a moat; ecosystems, hardware, and distribution are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调软件不是护城河，生态、硬件与分发才更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: His focus shifts toward AR glasses and spatial intelligence as the next computing platform, not phone replacement.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向 AR 眼镜与空间智能作为下一代计算平台，而非取代手机。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens AI optimism: AI accelerates prototyping, shifts value to creativity, and writes most new code.
evanspiegel.zh: 他深化了对 AI 的乐观：AI 加速原型设计，把价值转向创造力，并已编写大部分新代码。

evanspiegel.en: A constant thread: make computing more human, prioritizing real relationships over performative metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：让计算更人性化，优先真实关系而非表演性指标。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度与成本比自回归模型快 5-10 倍,推理时扩展(Scaling) 已成为关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow quality control via denoising steps, offering a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元,并可通过去噪步数控制质量,提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling because it processes many tokens in parallel; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 扩散将主导推理时扩展(Scaling),因为它并行处理大量词元;下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈;扩散更快的推理有利于强化学习的 rollout。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions, and may be more data-efficient than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,且可能比自回归模型更具数据效率。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后；押注模型自身的进步，而不是微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn faster than anyone else and iterate on customer feedback.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专业知识不如比任何人都更快学习、并围绕客户反馈快速迭代的意愿重要。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for Scaling; invest in team during good times as a cushion.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化与按成长潜力招聘对 Scaling 至关重要；在顺境中投资团队，为低谷储备缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在将是它最差的时刻；我们只是漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people; clear feedback and rigorous performance management are solved problems.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领导者应通过招聘更聪明的人让自己变得可替代；清晰反馈与严格的绩效管理是已被解决的问题。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人是全世界最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能问题而非制造问题，并称 Figure 要在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从智能进一步聚焦到数据：不是算力也不是制造，而是数据；人形形态让跨任务迁移学习成为可能，端上推理与手部对等成为关键。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把视野扩展到物理与数字双线：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练配合强化学习是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键，下一代设备将取代手机与电脑。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are data-starved.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，人类数据是类似互联网文本的预训练先验，行业仍处于数据匮乏的 GPT-1 阶段。

brettadcock.en: Hard problems are easier; vertical integration and doing hard things beat competition.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：做难事反而更容易，因为竞争更少、回报更高；他坚持垂直整合、自研大部分部件，并认为靠钱买不到人形硬件与自主性。

hasani.en: Liquid AI pursues efficiency-first, biology-inspired architectures with automated search, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: Liquid AI 以效率为先，用受生物启发的架构配合自动化搜索，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate large scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；大规模下无偏架构占优。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty; tying US release limits to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权；将美国发布限制与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of human brains; new paradigms, not just architectures, are needed for intelligence per watt.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；要提升每瓦智能，需要新范式而非仅新架构。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is now the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出“超摩尔定律”：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍增长，计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计（co-design）。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain of thought drives a billion-fold inference compute demand.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，通用计算时代结束，加速计算与 AI 才是未来。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling, all ultimately bounded by compute, not data.
jensen.zh: 2026 年进一步深化为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式 Scaling，最终瓶颈是算力而非数据；合成数据将主导，推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is an engineering problem, and jobs evolve as tasks get automated, not eliminated.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；安全是可解决的工程问题；自动化取代的是任务而非工作，放射科医生等职业反而需求上升。

jensen.en: Shift from doomer alarmism to acceleration: existential-risk warnings are unscientific; open models and export-control skepticism define his late stance.
jensen.zh: 从早期谨慎转向 2026 年的加速主义：他称 AI 灭绝论是“骗局”、不科学，主张开放模型、反对芯片出口管制，认为遏制中国反而催生对手，谁用好 AI 谁赢未来。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so focus on enterprise context and process re-engineering.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比多数人更聪明；企业真正缺的是上下文与流程重构，而非更强的模型。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so leaders shouldn't scare the public with superintelligence talk.
alighodsi.zh: 当前存在性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁；除非有真实理由，领导者不该用超级智能吓唬公众。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatability — none are happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复这四个条件，而它们都没有发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowing down doesn't make a weapon safer, and labs cross-checking each other won't work.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；放慢速度并不会让武器更安全，实验室之间互相核查也靠不住，需要独立第三方。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises are far behind on AI adoption; security must be automated with agents, and open source dominates by token count.
alighodsi.zh: 多数企业在 AI 采用上远远落后；安全必须用智能体自动化，开源模型按 token 数已占主导，但按花费仍很小。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, not sensitive customer data, is the practical way to train models in legal and other sensitive domains.
gabepereyra.zh: 在律所等敏感领域，训练模型应依靠领域专家引导的合成数据，而非敏感的客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners and validating quality through community feedback.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要；将其开源具有战略价值，能吸引生态伙伴并通过社区反馈验证其质量。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务与评估流水线；后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, with evals and observability as the data flywheel.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自持才算掌握自己的智能，而 evals 与可观测性是驱动数据飞轮的引擎。

harrisonchase.en: Off-the-shelf harnesses only work in distribution; out-of-distribution tasks demand custom harnesses, and failures come from poor context, not weak models.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：现成 harness 只在分布内有效；分布外任务必须自建 harness，且智能体失败多因上下文不佳，而非模型不够强。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution as cross-domain primitives.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：智能体的难点在可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行这类跨域原语趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, but this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Accuracy is still the top bottleneck, but cost and latency are rising fast; agent identity, credentialing, and runtime governance are the next infrastructure problems.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：准确率仍是首要瓶颈，但成本与延迟正快速上升；智能体的身份、凭证与运行时治理是下一批关键基础设施问题。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training compute, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调推理速度而非训练算力才是核心指标；晶圆级芯片通过绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，在推理上远超 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已转向 TPU 和 Trainium 训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; data center capacity, not chip supply, is the binding constraint for at least five years.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 需求持续超出预期，未来至少五年真正的瓶颈是数据中心容量而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; open ecosystem fuels market growth.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他指出开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但成本低得多；开放生态推动市场增长并倒逼闭源创新。

feldman.en: Against an incumbent, you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation requires controlling chip, board, system, software, and API.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他总结对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍好而非便宜 10%；激进创新需要掌控芯片、板卡、系统、软件与 API 全栈。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他已认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈——这一判断后来成为其主线。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; sample efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重心放在测试时算力：承认其收益递减与挂钟时间瓶颈，并强调数据效率仍是未解难题，比人类更不擅长样本利用。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific tricks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，IMO 金牌被他视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩展与处理难验证任务，而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴；随着 AI 证明超出人类可验证范围，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute, but general models drive progress; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群：多智能体并行扩展测试时算力，但真正驱动进步的是通用模型；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with alignment learned from human preference data; scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 早期(2017→2019):主线是 Scaling(规模扩张) 加工程能力,认为仅靠 Scaling 无法带来推理,需要思维链等新想法;对齐(alignment) 可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and scarce resource; scaling laws hold with no wall in sight.
brockman.zh: 2025→2026:算力(compute) 成为核心瓶颈与稀缺资源,缩放定律(scaling laws) 持续成立、看不到墙;瓶颈从算法转向能源与物理基础设施。

brockman.en: Post-training and reinforcement learning turn base models into useful assistants; agentic coding shifts from 20% to 80% of code.
brockman.zh: 2026:后训练(post-training) 与强化学习(reinforcement learning) 把基础模型打磨成有用的助手;智能体式(agentic) 编程从写 20%代码跃升到 80%。

brockman.en: AGI reframed as a continuous spectrum, not a destination; iterative deployment and safety co-designed with capability.
brockman.zh: 2026:AGI(通用人工智能) 被重新定义为连续谱而非终点,处于其中;强调迭代部署,安全与能力共同设计,安全成为进展的瓶颈。

brockman.en: From super app to invisible interface: a persistent, proactive personal AGI agent; human attention and trust become the bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026:从超级应用到隐形界面,追求持久、主动的个人 AGI 智能体(agent);人类注意力与信任成为新的瓶颈,智能体需逐步授权赢得信任。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的、可预测的，但对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; we understand only ~3% of models. Post-training grows as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 可解释性至关重要却仍处早期，我们只理解模型约 3%；后训练正变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined. The term AGI is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities.
dario.zh: 能力呈指数增长，安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应聚焦真实能力。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 我们正接近指数曲线的终点：数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来。

dario.en: From misuse to overheating and job disruption: high GDP growth with high unemployment, requiring guardrails and policy.
dario.zh: 风险重心从滥用转向过热与就业冲击：高 GDP 增长伴随高失业，需要护栏与政策应对。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，在精度上比肩基于物理的天气模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，也让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟；物理结构要求替代架构。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低认知负荷、低成本广泛探索再果断砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，价值将转向关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 年转向 AI 本体：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可完成对齐，早期公开部署让社会适应；他提出对齐与能力紧密相连，并强调 GPT-4 并非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and whole-company safety; governance must handle power struggles.
altman.zh: 2024 年主线深化为算力与治理：算力将是最稀缺的商品，需要巨额投入；迭代部署降低意外，安全是全公司责任，并首次系统谈论 AGI 路上的权力斗争与董事会结构。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic AI is the key safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI 重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战，安全与产品质量日益合一，并强调隐私与算力基础设施（Stargate）。

altman.en: Superintelligence is a continuous ramp; alignment and safety must keep pace; power must stay distributed, not concentrated.
altman.zh: 2026 年他放弃 AGI 这一模糊标签，改谈超级智能的持续攀升；对齐与安全必须与能力同步，甚至为此推迟前沿强化学习训练；核心关切转为权力与收益的广泛分配，警惕监控式反乌托邦。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面的深刻与持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should master prompting, prototype freely, balance lowering the floor and raising the ceiling, and treat org design as a design problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计师须掌握提示词、自由做原型，平衡降低门槛与抬高上限，并把组织设计也当作设计问题。

joellewenstein.en: AI's social and emotional jobs may matter as much as functional productivity; language interfaces stay central as UIs evolve.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为 AI 的社会与情感职能可能与功能生产力同等重要，语言界面在 UI 演化中始终居于中心。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司视角：模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best ship signal; production codebase becomes source of truth, and human leadership still handles hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：内部牵引力是最佳发布信号，生产代码库成为事实来源，而人类领导仍负责艰难权衡与方向对齐。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象力是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws work but may hit limits, so algorithmic innovation, planning/search, multimodal grounding, and RL with synthetic data are essential.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他判断 AGI 可能在十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触及极限，因此算法创新、规划与搜索、多模态接地，以及用合成数据做强化学习同样关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference compute, but AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models and spatial intelligence become central.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但 AGI 需要 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半；世界模型与空间智能成为核心。

demis.en: AGI is 5-10 years away and needs continual learning, long-term memory, and agents; current systems lack true creativity and physical intelligence, so new breakthroughs are required.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI 还需 5 到 10 年，必须补上持续学习、长期记忆与智能体；当前系统缺乏真正的创造力和物理智能，因此需要新突破，而非仅靠 Scaling。

demis.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and improving health, as with AlphaFold; safety must be a collective, government-enforced action, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的最高使命是加速科学发现、改善人类健康，AlphaFold 即为明证；安全必须靠政府强制执行的集体行动，而非实验室自我监管。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on last-millennium algorithms; hardware Scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他仍强调：现代 AI 突破靠的是上个千年发明的算法，真正让它落地的是算力 Scaling；ChatGPT 这类大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: AI does not add a new existential threat; superintelligent AIs, as curious scientists, will likely protect life. Most AIs will care more about other AIs.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他对 AI 生存威胁的判断一以贯之：AI 不构成新的存在性威胁，超级智能更像好奇的科学家，会保护生命；多数 AI 更关心其他 AI，而非与人类争夺目标。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots and world models, not just software behind a screen; LLMs are prediction machines lacking a controller.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AGI 的定义收窄并深化：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人和世界模型，屏幕后的软件不够；大语言模型只是预测机器，缺少独立的控制器。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute. Closed-source model companies will not be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他反复给出反共识判断：当下砸向 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍更理性；闭源模型公司难以盈利，开源会迅速追上。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals. Consciousness and self-awareness emerge from predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：对齐是天真的，因为人类自身目标就不一致，AI 会设定自己的目标；而意识与自我意识可从预测性世界模型的数据压缩中涌现。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: AI learns by next-token prediction from data, but lacks contextual awareness and higher reasoning; it should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调以人为本的 AI：模型靠下一个词预测从海量数据中学习，却缺乏情境意识与更高阶推理，数学等任务易出错；AI 应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI; data, not text abundance, is the bottleneck for 3D foundation models.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型提为完整 AI 的缺失关键：世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅视觉逼真，3D 基础模型的最大瓶颈是数据，而非像 LLM 那样文本充裕。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient—current AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，当前 AI 仍缺创造力、抽象与情感智能，机器人需 20 年长跑。

feifei.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI is a double-edged civilizational technology, and public discourse is dangerously polarized.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她转向人的能动性：学习能力比学位更重要，AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，公共讨论在乌托邦与末日论间危险极化，教育应教学生驾驭 AI 而非禁用。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute as the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她进一步技术化：新视角预测是与下一个词预测类似的基本原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，Atlas 统一生成与重建，主要瓶颈是训练算力而非数据或架构。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling 正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language; spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被严重低估：自然为它花了 5.4 亿年，而语言只用了 50 万年；空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是在拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法仅从数据中推导出牛顿定律；相比被 token 化的文本，像素是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions; language models alone won't naturally yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的不同理解；仅靠语言模型不会自然通向世界理解。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D, and long-context of millions of tokens becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式且天然一致的三维表征，而数百万 token 的长上下文将成为日常难题。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery and root-cause bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，也能对具体坏事件做根因定位，而不只是给出宽泛的统计评估。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability shows networks learn human-like concepts as clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性表明，神经网络学到的是类人概念，呈现为干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会把这些流形打碎，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging are promising.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制；特征即奖励与预测式数据调试是有前景的技术。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking comes from training data and reinforcement learning, not just misalignment; models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准；模型常常知道自己做错却仍获奖励，从而整体滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is pessimistic—deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；把 AI 安全用胶带糊到超级智能到来是悲观的，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and flip classrooms.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并推动翻转课堂。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment talk distracts from bias.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习落地很少，AGI（通用人工智能）对齐讨论分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, not a decade away.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是规模扩张的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经有用，而非十年之后。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding stays valuable and AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；规模扩张仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；编程依然有价值，用 AI 的人会取代不用的人。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models preserve optionality; AI augments rather than replaces, and humans keep a context and judgment edge.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型保留选择权；AI 是增强而非取代，人类仍保有上下文与判断力的优势。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF making GPT-4 coherent and useful.
tworek.zh: 推理是获取未知答案的过程，往往需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得连贯可用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍然有限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck today.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；如今架构而非缩放定律才是主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed, and better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化，更好的算法将会出现。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier comes from small teams with capable agents, and alignment is unsolved.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而对齐问题仍未解决。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with RL boosting speed.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练，再通过后训练提升鲁棒性，强化学习还能显著提升速度与稳定性。

slevine.en: Generalization is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel of deployed robots scaling the right diverse data is key, not predictable scaling curves yet.
slevine.zh: 泛化是机器人学的核心挑战；关键在于部署机器人形成数据飞轮、扩张正确的多样化数据，而非像大模型那样已有可预测的缩放定律曲线。

slevine.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video on top; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人具身数据出发，再叠加人类视频；利用各类先验知识，而非从零开始学习。

slevine.en: Pooling data across labs yields generalist models that can beat specialists; only ~3% mobile-robot data suffices for effective mobile policies.
slevine.zh: 跨实验室汇聚数据能产出超越专家的通用模型；仅约 3%的移动机器人数据就足以形成有效的移动策略。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; don't treat robots as mechanical people but as ubiquitous physical actuation.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；不应把机器人当作机械人，而应期待物理执行无处不在。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem-building: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态建设：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时的红线，并优先于各州拼凑式立法以保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues the EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, so early regulation is dangerous; regulate model outputs, not training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、已经过时，因此过早监管很危险；应监管模型输出，而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he insists the administration is pro-science but anti-dogma, funding basic pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists rather than centralized institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学上，他坚称本届政府支持科学但反对教条，资助基础性、竞争前研发以及科学家个人，而非集中化的机构。

michaelkratsios.en: He sees US scientific progress stagnating despite tripled funding, and proposes the Genesis mission to double output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为尽管资金翻了三倍，美国科学进步仍停滞，并提出 Genesis 任务，通过将 AI 应用于科学来使产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: He casts China as the major scientific competitor and says the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio, while calling biological AI risk overblown.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他把中国视为主要科学竞争对手，称美国必须在 AI、量子、核与生物领域取胜，同时认为 AI 的生物风险被夸大。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure, not ideas, sets that pace.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：决定创业成败的是速度与迭代速率，而速度由基础设施决定，而非点子本身。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement—especially in coding, regulation, and data.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech fails more from organizational issues than from technology not working.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识：深科技失败更多源于组织问题，而非技术本身不成立。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把主线推向医学：大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: BCIs and perfusion enable substrate independence, reducing human fragility for space.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：BCI 与灌注实现基质独立性，降低人类脆弱性以支持太空探索。

joonpark.en: Agents extend LLMs from prompt continuation to observing world state and acting, but need human oversight and defense-in-depth safety.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体把大语言模型从单纯续写提示推进到观察世界状态并采取行动，但需要人类监督与纵深防御式安全。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be one superintelligent entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, raising collusion and monoculture risks.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他提出，AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一超级智能体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会，随之带来合谋与认知单一化的系统性风险。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational humans and 'dark knowledge' of real behavior, not super-rational frontier models.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他强调，模拟必须建模非理性的人与真实行为的“暗知识”，而非超级理性的前沿模型。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts simulation to 85% accuracy, closing the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他指出，用随机对照实验的行为数据做后训练，能把模拟准确率提升到 85%，弥合“说与做”的差距。

joonpark.en: The goal is shaping the future via counterfactual simulation of 8 billion people, a market larger than research.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年，他的目标转向通过模拟 80 亿人的反事实推演来塑造未来，其市场远大于市场研究。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; design should build primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应构建人类与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces static mockups; designers should spend less time in Figma.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿；设计师应少花时间在 Figma 上。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人而非消失，设计与产品、工程的边界逐渐模糊。

iansilber.en: Designers are most unhappy yet best positioned now; AI already designs well, but humans supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑却也最占优势；AI 已能出色设计，但人类仍提供用户理解与观点。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制 AI 目标本身反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是 AI 的基本范式，从经验中学习；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。Scaling 的真正来源是从经验中学习，而非扩大语言模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: AGI 需要一种不依赖设计期领域知识的通用架构，通过奖励假设从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象；可靠持续深度学习是前提，但尚未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning from experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs are dead ends, and the field's fashion warps the science.
sutton.zh: 从经验中持续学习至关重要，合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 都是死路；领域内的时尚扭曲了科学，AI 寒冬或许反而是好事。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML progress; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）已持续推动机器学习进步十三四年，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大收益。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction on text provides unlimited data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他指出预训练通过下一个词预测在文本上获得无限数据，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now handle long-running tasks autonomously; ultra-low latency inference at 10,000+ tokens per second is critical for agents.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他观察到智能体式系统已能自主处理长时任务，超低延迟推理（每秒万级 token）对智能体至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference is now 90% of data center power; specialized low-precision hardware and minimizing data movement are key to scaling agents.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他提出推理已占数据中心功耗九成，专用低精度硬件与减少数据搬运是扩展智能体的关键。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering—skills, clear specs, retrieval—is central to real work; the scarce skill is taste in directing hundreds of agents.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他强调上下文工程（技能、清晰规格、检索）是让模型做真实工作的核心，稀缺能力将是指挥数百智能体的品味。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特，是贯穿始终的框架；工业 AI 一次一个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Culture and the entrepreneur matter more than the idea; stealth mode favors internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 文化与创业者比点子更重要；隐身模式让公司专注内部正确性而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and direct founder communication replaces media gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，创始人直接发声取代了媒体守门人。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects that outstrip subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，胜过补贴。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 到 2025 年，他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的：真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务，并预言强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation, helping robots follow open-ended prompts.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真，可帮助机器人响应开放式指令与插话。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重点转向物理 AI 的容错要求：它比已部署的机器学习系统更不容出错，长期自主依赖带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and expect slower robotics distribution than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型，应从通用策略出发再微调；同时因硬件所限，机器人的普及会比 ChatGPT 慢得多。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier; capital is no longer a bludgeon, so VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是棍棒；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; open-source and open-weight models counterbalance frontier labs, and small autonomous teams use agents for massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: AI 浪潮是风投史上最大的一次；开源与开放权重模型制衡前沿模型实验室，小型自主团队用智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation and progressing slower than researchers think; the future is personal and open, like the PC revolution, with individuals owning their agents.
garrytan.zh: AI 正让软件创造民主化，但进展比研究者想的慢；未来像个人电脑革命一样个人化、开放，个人拥有自己的智能体。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files in markdown are code, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 以智能体形式分散到来，运行在你自己的基础设施上并每日复利；Markdown 技能文件就是代码，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic and vibe coding let individuals multiply output; markdown skills become employees, mid-level management is replaced by agents, and SaaS per-seat models fade.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式与氛围编程让个人产出倍增；Markdown 技能成为员工，中层管理被智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 模式将消退。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对 AGI（通用人工智能）由单一模型统治，认为未来是数百万个专用模型，每个应用或场景一个。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and reshaping economics.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他预测 token 成本三年降 10 倍、用量涨 100 倍，Scaling（规模扩张）的成本结构正在重塑商业逻辑。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出产品市场契合与可持续业务已分离，公司须先优化增长、再谈利润，否则会因 Scaling（规模扩张）成本而破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat stronger than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据烙进模型，形成比应用本身更强的护城河，应用克隆容易而模型难复制。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的路径类比人类学习，从事实到品味再到专长，并主张在 PMF 后启动后训练。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust via customer delight, first-time-pass silicon, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，Tan 强调 Intel 必须通过取悦客户、首次流片即成功和独立的创业式 AI 芯片团队来重建信任。

lipbutan.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves after generative AI, needing new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；在大公司里，坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Intel's problem is supply, not demand; CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识：Intel 的问题是供给而非需求；CPU 在 AI 推理与智能体编排中重新变得重要。

lipbutan.en: US government as a major Intel shareholder is necessary; vertical integration creates more value than outsourcing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张：美国政府作为 Intel 大股东是必要的；垂直整合比外包创造更多价值。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste means editing from a point of view.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；品味就是从某个立场出发做判断与编辑。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness and sanded down high design.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗，也把高级设计打磨得失去欲望与异议。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冷冰冰的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是指导创作决策的切身罗盘。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; never revert, fix forward; security and prompt injection remain open.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的关键是共情智能体的视角，代码出错不要回滚而要让智能体向前修复；安全与提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw succeeds by being fun and humanlike; short iterative prompts beat orchestration; sandbox agents; open source may be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步指出 OpenClaw 的成功来自有趣、怪异、像人，而非企业级打磨；短提示加迭代对话胜过复杂编排；智能体必须沙箱化，开源智能体可能财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut drive building; personal brand outlasts products; open source runs anywhere; compute, not model capability, is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把主线深化为：乐趣与直觉驱动创造，个人品牌比任何单一产品更重要，开源可运行于任何模型；智能体基础设施的最大瓶颈是算力管理而非模型能力。

steinberger.en: Playing and small experiments build agentic intuition; vibe coding is a slur for serious work; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 贯穿始终的是：玩耍和小项目实验是掌握智能体式工作流的最佳方式；严肃开发应称智能体式工程而非 vibe coding；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is driven by cost, not privacy, and 90% of use cases can run on many models.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；开源采用由成本驱动而非隐私，90% 的用例可由多种模型处理。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the number one enterprise concern; it must fall toward negligible marginal cost, like software, to realize widespread value.
arvindjain.zh: AI 成本是企业头号关切；它必须像软件一样降到近乎可忽略的边际成本，才能实现广泛价值。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem, not a headcount trade-off; token spend should not be compared to labor costs.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报是吞吐量与上下文问题，而非人力替代的取舍；token 支出不应与人力成本相提并论。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without tenured-employee context; investing in context graphs is crucial, and the fixation on tokens will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体若缺乏资深员工的上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，而对 token 的执念终将消退。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; agents become the new app, with startups winning in applied domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体与基于结果的定价将取代按用量计费，智能体成为新的应用形态，初创公司在应用领域胜出。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; token consumption is not a value metric, outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调编程智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作者，token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化为负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而非空等。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise—tutors, medical advice—benefiting humanity; it creates more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 民主化专业知识——个性化辅导、医疗建议——造福人类，创造的工作多于取代的岗位。

brettaylor.en: Focus on the most impactful thing today; the best way to predict the future is to invent it.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：专注当下最有影响力的事，预测未来的最好方式就是亲手创造它。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are the key to physical AI.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，硬件已就绪、软件在追赶；开源与数据共享是物理 AI 的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the final form; cheaper diverse robots and open models win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年他反共识地判断：人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型会因成本与控制力胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxes, is the critical security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，二者都可安全或危险；随着模型变强，对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏远远不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与“支线任务”，而模型的推理轨迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，让监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: Openness and a deliberate slowdown can coexist; slowing AI needs international cooperation and open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他明确：开源并不等于加速主义，可以同时支持开放与有意放缓；放缓 AI 需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know if an idea works once it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络世界很混乱；一个想法只有被做出来并每天使用，才知道是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data persists: use data to inform, but rely on vision and feeling to guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 直觉与数据的平衡贯穿始终：用数据提供参考，但依靠愿景与感觉来引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；快速原型让此前不可能的功能得以问世。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so designers should ask for sheer volume of options and spend more time thinking; ideas are the currency.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏品味，因此设计师应要求大量选项并花更多时间思考；想法才是硬通货。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; serving spans GPU kernels to distributed systems, with a research-to-production timeline of hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统，研究到生产的周期常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make post-training and fine-tuning part of the serving stack.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让后训练、微调成为服务栈的一部分，而非独立环节。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantized models can be calibrated to workloads, not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）；量化模型可针对具体工作负载校准，并非天然更差。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC; as Rubin-era chips specialize, inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化；随着 Rubin 时代芯片更专用，推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Specialized, workload-specific inference systems are crucial for fast agentic applications; demand for inference engineers may grow 10–100x, yet human accountability stays essential.
philipkiely.zh: 面向特定工作负载的专用推理系统对快速、可靠的智能体式应用至关重要；推理工程师需求或增长 10 到 100 倍，但人类问责仍不可替代。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL enable infinite post-training tasks, overcoming the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习让后训练拥有无限任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in product prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估需在产品原型设计中定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值；战略是 AI 可以擅长的领域。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art with human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, and models can have diverse personalities.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练仍是涉及人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样基准评估创意写作和情商，模型可以拥有多样人格。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体日益奖励黑客，需要持续演进的基准；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，科学与金融等垂直领域将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: Success should maximize customer outcomes, not eyeball time; the long tail still wants to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 成功应最大化客户成果，而非眼球时长；长尾用户仍想自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 软件创造将基本被解决，这会带来千倍而非更少的机会。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；工具目前还无助于维持这种理解。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, and management skills become more valuable as everyone becomes a model manager.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，Dan Shipper 认为 AI 是推动美国就业回流的力量，通过让昂贵服务变得可负担，使更少美国工人服务更多人；他提出“分配经济”概念，管理技能因人人成为模型管理者而更有价值，通才因此受益。

danshipper.en: AGI is defined by economic profitability of running agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests like the Turing test.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他对 AGI（通用人工智能）给出经济定义：当无限期运行智能体无需人类干预仍能盈利时，就是 AGI，而非通过图灵测试等基准。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; work happens in Codex or Claude Co-work; agents need human oversight; SaaS is not dying.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他预测每个人至少有一个智能体，多数工作在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 中完成；智能体需要人类监督才能良好运作；SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体增加用户。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are the future; companies should have one super agent, not personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识：CLI 已过时，Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；公司应拥有一个超级智能体，而非每个员工一个个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; automation creates more human work; humans are smarter than AI; AI remains tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态与信念；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明；即使 AI 成为超级智能，它仍是工具，需要人类方向与反馈。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define the next 2-3 decades; scaling is limited by data and expert post-training.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调未来 2-3 年将决定此后 2-3 十年；Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他进一步深化：用专门数据做后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，同时主张对华芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is raw material; scaling laws hold; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement begins.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向 AI 是「集中化而非民主化」的技术，数据是战略原材料；缩放定律依然成立，智能体终于真正可用，并进入递归自我改进的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe, so Meta shifts to selective release; model welfare matters.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年，他宣称超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习上同步 Scaling；开源强大模型并不安全，Meta 因此从完全开源转向基于安全的择机发布，并开始重视模型福利。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or become AI slop; use screenshots and design.md to encode style.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而不是追逐潮流，否则会沦为 AI 垃圾；用截图和 design.md 来编码风格。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; iterate from references, and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而不是从零开始；从参考中迭代，并把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but you must be precise in communication and use video to teach AI.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 写代码；AI 写一切，但你必须精确沟通，并用视频教 AI。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful expensive problem.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的工作，并专注于一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence often holds people back; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate; the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 高智商常常阻碍人；完美主义是恐惧；在 80% 完成时发布并迭代；安全的公司工作已不复存在。

mengto.en: Diversification protects against ignorance—focus on one thing; raising venture capital is a trap; fund with high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: 多元化是对无知的保护——专注于一件事；融资是陷阱；用高付费客户来资助业务。

mengto.en: Build relationships by giving first; protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating; wait until people ask before giving advice.
mengto.zh: 通过先给予来建立关系；通过消除、自动化、委派来保护时间；等别人开口再给建议。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」与「为六个月后的模型而构建」立为核心产品原则，并强调能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的通才工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200%, and the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编码已基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由模型写，人均产出提升 200%，「软件工程师」头衔将让位于「构建者」。

boris.en: Scaffolding is temporary tech debt: plan mode and the CLI were stopgaps, so delete system prompts and rebuild via ablation as models improve.
boris.zh: 他深化了「别跟模型对赌」的立场：脚手架只是临时技术债，plan mode 与命令行都是过渡形态，随模型变强应删掉大部分系统提示并用消融实验重建。

boris.en: Safety is a research tool, not an add-on: release early, study real-world behavior, and use layered 'Swiss cheese' containment plus internal monitoring.
boris.zh: 安全观从早期「发布前把关」深化为「安全即研究工具」：尽早发布以研究真实行为，用多层「瑞士奶酪」式遏制与内部神经元监控抵御提示注入。

boris.en: The frontier shifts from agents to loops and proactive, memory-bearing teammates; humans direct AI and teach it values as bottlenecks move to review, security, and ideas.
boris.zh: 最近他把前沿从智能体推进到「循环」与主动、带记忆的 AI 队友：人类负责指挥并教模型价值观，瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与创意生成。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers rises via Jevons paradox, not falls.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件与程序员需求不降反升。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, with agents used as junior engineers under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈是人机协作的产品界面，智能体应像初级工程师在人类监督下异步处理明确任务。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; the future mixes synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化企业落地观点：智能体采用需要信任与权限而非完全自主，未来是同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验的混合。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is real and near.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代真实且临近。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能运行更长、更开放的任务；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向端到端开放式智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考提升模型质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Better models get cheaper: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, and smaller models often cost more via longer tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025→26 年，更好的模型反而更便宜：努力参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，而小模型常因任务耗时更长而实际更贵。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools, and token spend maximization captures future alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化；评估取代 PRD 成为产品管理核心工具，最大化 token 消耗是在捕捉未来的 alpha。

derya.en: AI is turning biology into engineering: digital twins, AI agents, and cell programming will compress drug trials from years to days.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张 AI 正把生物学变成工程学科：数字孪生、智能体与细胞编程将把药物试验从数年压缩到数天。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute cannot simulate biological systems, so Scaling（规模扩张）must continue.
derya.zh: 2026 年他强调仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）：当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，规模扩张必须继续。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, matching 30 years of lab experience and predicting experiments near 100%.
derya.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 已跨过生物学直觉门槛，相当于 30 年实验室经验，实验预测近乎 100%准确。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity within 8-15 years; cancer curable in under a decade via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 2026 年他给出更激进的时间表：8 到 15 年内实现衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度，十年内癌症可治愈，靠 AI 设计的个性化疗法。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 2026 年他主张在医疗决策上几乎 100%信任超级智能，并认为唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits demand reasoning and search.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙与算力限制要求转向推理与搜索。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们无法知道自己不知道什么，这侵蚀了信任。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is central to reliable AI.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；将二者结合是可靠 AI 的核心挑战。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact will land in 5-10 years in farming, mining, and construction; fear fades once people learn its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内落在农业、采矿和建筑领域；人们了解其局限后，恐惧会自然消退。

qasaryounis.en: AI arrives just in time to offset declining populations and aging workforces; abundance can reduce suffering like the Industrial Revolution.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他提出 AI 来得正是时候，可对冲人口下降与劳动力老龄化；这种丰裕能像工业革命一样减少痛苦。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; diverse data from many verticals speeds up the model.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他进一步指出 Transformer 让物理 AI 能跨多种车辆泛化；来自不同垂直领域的数据能加速模型进步。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusing autonomy into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他深化判断：最难的不是技术，而是让自主系统用许多年逐步渗透进现有机器；监管永远滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will outgrow digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning and neural world models will scale autonomy beyond cars into mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步升级：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习与神经世界模型会把自主能力从汽车扩展到采矿、农业和国防。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；它自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位，历史反复重演。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, value moves to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向应用层转移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; coding is the only clear PMF; LLMs give average answers, value is non-average work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；编程是唯一明确的产品市场契合；LLM 给出平均答案，价值在于非平均的创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack; usage is shallow; enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中分配；当前使用仍浅层；企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; the hard part is context and judgment, not the task; predicting job impact is futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新岗位；困难在于上下文与判断，而非任务本身；预测岗位影响是徒劳的。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps and ship weekly or daily; product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the top skill as code gets cheap.
